blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) and the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB) are integrating their systems to enhance crop estimates. The DA said the collaboration aims to address a longstanding challenge in agricultural planning caused by fragmented data and overlapping monitoring systems.
